projects.description: Fits the Supernova Cosmology Project Union2.1 Hubble diagram (distance modulus mu vs redshift z for 580 SNe Ia) with a flat Lambda-CDM model, constraining the two free parameters H0 and Omega_Lambda (with Omega_m = 1 - Omega_Lambda). A single fit produces the chi-square surface / posterior over (Omega_Lambda, H0), from which the analysis reports best-fit H0 and Omega_Lambda with uncertainties, the Hubble diagram with the best-fit model overlaid, and the 68%/95% confidence...
